mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ja_attachment_blob(sha256,size_bytes,media_kind,media_type,created_at_ms) VALUES(#{sha256},#{sizeBytes},#{mediaKind},#{mediaType},#{createdAt,typeHandler=io.github.kongweiguang.ja.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.EpochMillisStringTypeHandler,jdbcType=BIGINT}) ON CONFLICT(sha256) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT a.attachment_id,a.workspace_id,a.blob_sha256,a.content_sha256,a.display_name,a.size_bytes, a.media_kind,a.media_type,a.status,a.created_at_ms,a.expires_at_ms, (SELECT ma.message_id FROM ja_message_attachment ma WHERE ma.attachment_id=a.attachment_id ORDER BY ma.created_at_ms,ma.message_id LIMIT 1) AS bound_message_id, COALESCE( (SELECT tra.thread_id FROM ja_tool_result_attachment tra WHERE tra.attachment_id=a.attachment_id ORDER BY tra.created_at_ms,tra.thread_id LIMIT 1), (SELECT fa.thread_id FROM ja_thread_fork_attachment fa WHERE fa.attachment_id=a.attachment_id ORDER BY fa.created_at_ms,fa.thread_id LIMIT 1)) AS bound_thread_id FROM ja_attachment a WHERE a.attachment_id=#{attachmentId}

SELECT a.attachment_id,a.workspace_id,a.blob_sha256,a.content_sha256,a.display_name,a.size_bytes, a.media_kind,a.media_type,a.status,a.created_at_ms,a.expires_at_ms, NULL AS bound_message_id,NULL AS bound_thread_id FROM ja_attachment a WHERE a.attachment_id=#{attachmentId} AND a.workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND a.status='DRAFT' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ja_turn_input_attachment p WHERE p.attachment_id=a.attachment_id)

WITH RECURSIVE readable_threads(thread_id,workspace_id,depth) AS ( SELECT thread_id,workspace_id,0 FROM ja_conversation_thread WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND deleted_at_ms IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT l.parent_thread_id,r.workspace_id,r.depth+1 FROM readable_threads r JOIN ja_conversation_lineage l ON l.child_thread_id=r.thread_id JOIN ja_task_context_seed s ON s.context_seed_id=l.context_seed_id JOIN ja_conversation_thread p ON p.thread_id=l.parent_thread_id AND p.workspace_id=r.workspace_id WHERE r.depth<4 AND p.deleted_at_ms IS NULL AND l.task_kind='SIDE_TASK' AND s.inheritance_mode='EFFECTIVE_CONTEXT' AND s.parent_thread_id=l.parent_thread_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(s.references_json) ref WHERE json_extract(ref.value,'$.kind')='attachment' AND json_extract(ref.value,'$.attachmentId')=#{attachmentId}) ) SELECT a.attachment_id,a.workspace_id,a.blob_sha256,a.content_sha256,a.display_name,a.size_bytes, a.media_kind,a.media_type,a.status,a.created_at_ms,a.expires_at_ms, (SELECT ma.message_id FROM ja_message_attachment ma JOIN ja_conversation_message owner ON owner.message_id=ma.message_id WHERE ma.attachment_id=a.attachment_id AND owner.thread_id IN (SELECT thread_id FROM readable_threads) ORDER BY ma.created_at_ms,ma.message_id LIMIT 1) AS bound_message_id, COALESCE( (SELECT tra.thread_id FROM ja_tool_result_attachment tra WHERE tra.attachment_id=a.attachment_id AND tra.thread_id IN (SELECT thread_id FROM readable_threads) ORDER BY tra.created_at_ms,tra.thread_id LIMIT 1), (SELECT fa.thread_id FROM ja_thread_fork_attachment fa WHERE fa.attachment_id=a.attachment_id AND fa.thread_id IN (SELECT thread_id FROM readable_threads) ORDER BY fa.created_at_ms,fa.thread_id LIMIT 1)) AS bound_thread_id FROM ja_attachment a WHERE a.attachment_id=#{attachmentId} AND a.workspace_id IN (SELECT workspace_id FROM readable_threads WHERE thread_id=#{threadId}) AND ((a.status='BOUND' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ja_message_attachment ma JOIN ja_conversation_message m ON m.message_id=ma.message_id WHERE ma.attachment_id=a.attachment_id AND m.thread_id IN (SELECT thread_id FROM readable_threads))) OR (a.status='BOUND' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ja_thread_fork_attachment fa WHERE fa.thread_id IN (SELECT thread_id FROM readable_threads) AND fa.attachment_id=a.attachment_id)) OR (a.status='BOUND' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ja_tool_result_attachment tra JOIN ja_tool_call tc ON tc.thread_id=tra.thread_id AND tc.turn_id=tra.turn_id AND tc.call_id=tra.call_id WHERE tra.thread_id IN (SELECT thread_id FROM readable_threads) AND tra.attachment_id=a.attachment_id AND tc.state='SUCCEEDED')) OR (a.status='DRAFT' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ja_turn_input_attachment pia JOIN ja_turn_input pi ON pi.input_id=pia.input_id AND pi.state='PENDING' WHERE pia.attachment_id=a.attachment_id AND pi.thread_id=#{threadId})))
mapper.update: UPDATE ja_attachment SET status='BOUND',bound_at_ms=#{boundAt,typeHandler=io.github.kongweiguang.ja.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.EpochMillisStringTypeHandler,jdbcType=BIGINT} WHERE attachment_id=#{attachmentId} AND status='DRAFT' AND expires_at_ms>#{boundAt,typeHandler=io.github.kongweiguang.ja.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.EpochMillisStringTypeHandler,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND blob_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ja_turn_input_attachment pia WHERE pia.attachment_id=ja_attachment.attachment_id) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ja_conversation_thread t JOIN ja_tool_call tc ON tc.thread_id=t.thread_id WHERE t.thread_id=#{threadId} AND t.workspace_id=ja_attachment.workspace_id AND t.deleted_at_ms IS NULL AND tc.turn_id=#{turnId} AND tc.call_id=#{callId} AND tc.state='SUCCEEDED')
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ja_message_attachment ma JOIN ja_conversation_message m ON m.message_id=ma.message_id JOIN ja_conversation_thread t ON t.thread_id=m.thread_id JOIN ja_attachment a ON a.attachment_id=ma.attachment_id WHERE ma.attachment_id=#{attachmentId} AND ma.message_id=#{messageId} AND m.thread_id=#{threadId} AND t.workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND a.workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND a.status='BOUND' AND a.blob_sha256 IS NOT NULL)
mapper.update: UPDATE ja_attachment SET status='DISCARDED',discarded_at_ms=#{discardedAt,typeHandler=io.github.kongweiguang.ja.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.EpochMillisStringTypeHandler,jdbcType=BIGINT},blob_sha256=NULL WHERE attachment_id=#{attachmentId} AND status='DRAFT' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ja_turn_input_attachment p WHERE p.attachment_id=#{attachmentId})

UPDATE ja_attachment SET status='BOUND',bound_at_ms=#{boundAt,typeHandler=io.github.kongweiguang.ja.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.EpochMillisStringTypeHandler,jdbcType=BIGINT} WHERE attachment_id=#{attachmentId} AND workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND status='DRAFT' AND expires_at_ms>#{boundAt,typeHandler=io.github.kongweiguang.ja.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.EpochMillisStringTypeHandler,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND blob_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ja_turn_input_attachment p WHERE p.attachment_id=ja_attachment.attachment_id)
mapper.select: SELECT input_id FROM ja_turn_input_attachment WHERE attachment_id=#{attachmentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE ja_attachment SET status='DISCARDED',discarded_at_ms=#{discardedAt,typeHandler=io.github.kongweiguang.ja.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.EpochMillisStringTypeHandler,jdbcType=BIGINT},blob_sha256=NULL WHERE attachment_id=#{attachmentId} AND status='DRAFT' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ja_turn_input_attachment p WHERE p.input_id=#{inputId} AND p.attachment_id=ja_attachment.attachment_id)

UPDATE ja_attachment SET status='DISCARDED',discarded_at_ms=#{discardedAt,typeHandler=io.github.kongweiguang.ja.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.EpochMillisStringTypeHandler,jdbcType=BIGINT},blob_sha256=NULL WHERE status='DRAFT' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ja_turn_input_attachment p WHERE p.input_id=#{inputId} AND p.attachment_id=ja_attachment.attachment_id)

UPDATE ja_attachment SET status='DISCARDED',discarded_at_ms=#{discardedAt,typeHandler=io.github.kongweiguang.ja.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.EpochMillisStringTypeHandler,jdbcType=BIGINT},blob_sha256=NULL WHERE status='DRAFT' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ja_turn_input_attachment p JOIN ja_turn_input i ON i.input_id=p.input_id WHERE i.turn_id=#{turnId} AND i.state='PENDING' AND p.attachment_id=ja_attachment.attachment_id)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ja_turn_input_attachment WHERE input_id IN ( SELECT input_id FROM ja_turn_input WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND state='PENDING')
mapper.update: UPDATE ja_attachment SET status='EXPIRED',expired_at_ms=#{expiredAt,typeHandler=io.github.kongweiguang.ja.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.EpochMillisStringTypeHandler,jdbcType=BIGINT},blob_sha256=NULL WHERE status='DRAFT' AND expires_at_ms<=#{expiredAt,typeHandler=io.github.kongweiguang.ja.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.EpochMillisStringTypeHandler,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ja_turn_input_attachment p WHERE p.attachment_id=ja_attachment.attachment_id)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ja_attachment_blob WHERE sha256=#{sha256} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ja_attachment a WHERE a.blob_sha256=#{sha256} AND a.status IN ('DRAFT','BOUND'))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ja_conversation_title_generation(generation_id,thread_id,turn_id,provider_id,model_id,config_generation,claimed_at_ms) VALUES(#{generationId},#{threadId},#{turnId},#{providerId},#{modelId},#{configGeneration},#{claimedAt,typeHandler=io.github.kongweiguang.ja.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.EpochMillisStringTypeHandler,jdbcType=BIGINT}) ON CONFLICT(thread_id) DO NOTHING
